title: AI Cash Flood Reshapes Global Finance
summary: Investment in artificial intelligence has reached unprecedented levels, revolutionizing global financial markets. This boom is speeding up AI adoption in trading algorithms, risk management, and customer services, marking a new era powered by machine intelligence.
